title: Why You Never Use a Sanitary Tee on Its Side
description: A common installation error in drainage piping is using a standard sanitary tee in a horizontal-to-horizontal branch connection. Sanitary tees are engineered specifically for transitioning from a horizontal branch into a vertical stack. When installed horizontally, the short sweep radius fails to direct solids smoothly, leading to standing wastewater, frequent clogs, and improper venting. For horizontal directional changes, plumbing codes require long-sweep elbows, wyes, or combination wye-and-eighth bends. Understanding proper fitting geometry ensures gravity drainage systems scour effectively and maintain continuous flow without obstruction.
